tellings.difference: Gives at least 1,400 documented sightings, puts them over Norway and Sweden, describes rocket and cigar shapes, and adds that the Swedish government formed a special military unit.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the 1940s Scandinavian ghost rocket wave whose objects never landed on the ground but went into water.

as_told.title: Swedish ghost rocket wave and the special military unit

plain: In the 1940s, the story goes, a swarm of at least 1,400 documented rocket- and cigar-shaped objects, called "ghost rockets", came down over Norway and Sweden, and they never landed or crashed on the ground but always plunged into water. Michels adds that the craze was serious enough for the Swedish government to form a special military unit. He tells it himself twice, once in a talk with a treasure hunter who says there is a UFO on the seafloor, as a sign that whatever these were had something to do with water.
